business_problem: With the UK currently facing the worst cost of living crisis in over 40 years, supporting customers through financial difficulty is quickly becoming one of today’s most pressing challenges. Ophelos is on a mission to transform the antiquated debt collection industry into one that’s empathetic, tech-driven, and fair for both business and consumer.
solution_summary: Ophelos built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Agent Bricks, Databricks Data + AI Platform, MLflow. With the UK currently facing the worst cost of living crisis in over 40 years, supporting customers through financial difficulty is quickly becoming one of today’s most pressing challenges. Ophelos is on a mission to transform the antiquated debt collection industry into one that’s empathetic, tech-driven, and fair for both business and consumer. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. MLflow tracks model experiments and repeatable machine learning workflows.
